notes.title: “TERAVIT” A Sandbox Game Created by Players PC/Steam Version Released April 20th
notes.content:
CyberStep, Inc. is pleased to announce the release of the brand new sandbox game "TERAVIT" for PC / Steam is now available as of [b]April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST)[/b].
　
To commemorate the release, amazing campaigns such as the [b]"1,000,000 Yen Split Prize Campaign"[/b], in which 1,000,000 Yen will be split among all participants, and the [b]"Release Campaign"[/b] where players can get up to 1,000 Jewels (In-game currency) by logging in or clearing worlds.

In addition, the Nintendo Switch version and smartphone version will be released in late May 2023, with the PlayStation 4 and 5 version releases planned for June 2023.

　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/7d3bfcfebab6abe01f2a870d95e816bf7ca3f3c3.jpg[/img]
　
TERAVIT Official Website
[url=https://teravit.app/]https://teravit.app/en[/url]


　
[b][h2]PC/Steam Versions of TERAVIT Released April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST)![/h2][/b]
The PC/Steam versions of the new Free-to-play Sandbox Game TERAVIT is now available as of April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST). 
　
　
[h3][b]◆A Sandbox Game with the three main elements of "Create, Play, and Share".[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/9402e01aad3cd8fad03148418f6940cf46b43de5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/fa852c79da366ca5e3b2da409a41ed93fda4554f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/3719ead795d8bbc82f09a01e48f73dbfb4000062.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]◆“Create to Earn” Game Model for Creators to Make Returns[/b][/h3]
[b]"Create to Earn"[/b] is a unique game model of "TERAVIT" where creators can earn returns when other players play their created worlds or purchase items in the world.
　
By registering for the [b]"Creators Site"[/b], you can receive returns from your created "World Items" and "Avatars"! Check the official website announcement for more information for more details.
　
Announcement URL：https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=content-en&id=16969
　
　
[h3][b]◆ More Releases to Follow on Various Platforms[/b][/h3]
This game supports cross-play, so worlds created in the PC/Steam version can be played by players of other platforms scheduled for release in the future.
　
Those who are waiting for the Nintendo Switch and smartphone versions, scheduled for release in late May, or the PlayStation 4 and 5 versions, scheduled for release in June, should also check out the PC/Steam versions to see what kind of worlds other players are creating.
　
Steam Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/

[h3][b]The 1,000,000 Yen Split Prize Campaign![/b][/h3]
To commemorate the release of "TERAVIT", the "1,000,000 Yen Split Prize Campaign!” for players who create a world will be held for a limited time starting on April 20th, 2023 (JST)!
　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/a687cfdf54d630201e851b87c31c9a417a98f918.jpg[/img]
　
Earn “Points that can be exchanged into Jewels or Cash” based on the number of times a world you created is played by other players!

A total of 1 Million Yen will be distributed to all participants in this BIG event, so be sure to participate! ♪

　
Announcement URL：https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=news-en&id=16908
　
　
Campaign Period：April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST) - May 22nd, 2023  23:59 (JST)
Requirements：1. Create a world
　　　　　　　2. Upload and open the created world publicly
Reward：Points valued at 1,000,000 Yen split between all campaign participants.
Important Notes：*Please confirm the campaign information on the official website.
　
[h3][b]Get up to 1,200 Yen worth of "Jewels" based on the number of logins and worlds cleared![/b][/h3]
[b]“Play Teravit and get Jewels! Release campaign!”[/b] will be held from after the release on Thursday April 20th, 2023.

In this campaign, players will receive 500 Jewels for the first login, and up to 500 more Jewels based on the number of uploaded worlds cleared.

　
Announcement URL：https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=news-en&id=16913
　

　
[h3][b]◆ Get 500 Jewels for the first log in![/b][/h3]
Log in to TERAVIT for the first time during the campaign and receive 500 Jewels.
Campaign Period：April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST) - May 11th, 2023  23:59 (JST)
Requirement：Log in to TERAVIT for the first time
Reward：500 Jewels
Important Notes：*Please check the campaign information on the official website.
　
　
[h3][b]◆ Get up to 500 Jewels by clearing worlds![/b][/h3]
Clear the worlds opened to the public in TERAVIT during the campaign and receive Jewels.
Get up to 500 Jewels by clearing the designated number of worlds!
Campaign Period：April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST) - May 11th, 2023  23:59 (JST)
Requirement：Clear the worlds opened to the public in TERAVIT
Reward：Get up to 500 Jewels based on the number of worlds cleared.
Please see the [url=https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=news-en&id=16913]announcement[/url] for more details.
Important Notes：*Please check the campaign information on the official website.
　

　
[h3][b]About TERAVIT[/b][/h3]
”TERAVIT” is [b]“A Sandbox Game Created by Players”[/b], which is Free-to-Play.
　
TERAVIT allows you to create a beautiful voxel world by assembling various blocks to [b]“make your own original game content”[/b] to add unique game elements to the world. In addition, the game supports multiplayer with cross-play, so you can cooperate with your friends to create a game world which can even be uploaded online and enjoyed by other players.

We offer a [b]"Create to Earn"[/b] game experience, where creators can earn returns when their uploaded worlds are played or items are purchased.
　
Official Website：https://teravit.app/en
Official Twitter：https://twitter.com/teravit_en
Official Discord：https://discord.gg/sZf2mrTngr
Official YouTube：https://www.youtube.com/@teravit1552
　
　
◆ Game Details
Title：TERAVIT
Genre：Sandbox Game Created by Players
Price：Free-to-play (With in-game Purchase)
Number of players：Multiplayer Support
Platforms：Windows® 8.1 / 10 / 11 
	   　　 Smartphone（iOS / Android）
   	   　　 Nintendo Switch™
   	  　　  PlayStation®4 / PlayStation®5

notes.title: 『コズミックブレイク GUN & SLASH』 Steamにて本日より発売開始！
notes.content:
Greetings from the 鋼鉄戦記C21 service team.

Cyberstep Co., Ltd. is pleased to announce that [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH], a spin-off work of the MMO battle shooting game [CosmicBreak], was released on Steam December 23, 2021, for 1,990 JPY. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6e1a2f05c9f74046d9a713888c325ef0e4bad8d8.png[/img]

The [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] store page can be found here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815020/


[h1]What is [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH]?[/h1]

[Cosmic Break GUN & SLASH] is a spin-off work of [Cosmic Break], an MMO battle shooting game in featuring robots and humanoids, active since 2008.

Set in the world of CosmicBreak, Gun & Slash is a top-down hack and slasher where players can control popular characters such as Zero Saber and Zero Saber Girl to defeat hordes of enemies!


[h1][CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] Features[/h1]

[h3]◆Charming characters![/h3]
Unlock and control 12 of the most popular characters from "CosmicBreak Universal"!
Characters will be released based on the number of stages you complete in Main Mode and your clear time!

[h3]◆Use your weapons to defeat the enemy![/h3]
Characters can equip up to two weapons, and each weapon has a Main Weapon and a Sub Weapon.
Switch between up to four weapons in your quest for victory!
Weapons are randomly dropped during the game in Main Mode.
Collect various weapons and skills and aim for victory!

[h3]◆Compete for the best record![/h3]
This game features a Main Mode, where players aim to defeat enemies or clear maps, a Time Attack Mode where they can compete for best clear time with players the world over, and a Challenge Mode, where players compete for longest survival time!
Time Attack Mode and Challenge Mode are compatible with Steam leaderboards.
Compete with players from all over the world to become a top ranker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/46716f6ec8b976865c5e8a80f7e507f7dedca934.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3fb0f9e2f4ba10145b881e01a01b02069abc0a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/db3df14a767653902599e3cf476df319832d3b85.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/cf184dbb391818380ea44a7d99c1df6656e2b916.jpg[/img]
*Images are taken during development and may differ from the final product.


[h2]◆Service Details[/h2]

Title: [Cosmic Break GUN & SLASH] 
Genre: Hack and Slash
Play Type: Single Player
Platform: PC(Steam)
Release Date: 12/23/2021 JST
Cost: 1,990 JPY
Available Languages: Japanese/English/Chinese (Traditional)

Thank you for your support of [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] and [鋼鉄戦記C21]!

notes.title: Teravit Global Alpha Test Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings 鋼鉄戦記C21 players!

We would like to announce that [b]the Global Alpha Test for CyberStep's latest title "Teravit" will be available[/b] from October 12th, 2021 15:00 (JST)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/e51d99c9a31addae35c045943181eecf3993ef1e.png[/img]

For the Global Alpha Test, voxel avatars can now be applied in Teravit.



[h2]What is Teravit?[/h2]Teravit is a multiplayer, open-world sandbox RPG that gives you the freedom to explore and adventure in a vast and diverse fantasy voxel world.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/NgQEmBPqcHI
- Teravit Store Page
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/[/url]


[h2]Exploring as Crimrose!? Create your own voxel avatar![/h2]During Teravit's Global Alpha Test, you will be able to edit your player character's avatar!

[h3]Let's use an Official Avatar![/h3]Teravit will be providing users with several voxel avatars that can be used during the Global Alpha Test. 

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/7b6ff7720d7e3e6cfe9790cbe7160247b98933d2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Let's make our own voxel avatar![/h3]You can make your own original avatar using MagicaVoxel!
For more information on how to download and install MagicaVoxel, and how to create and customize voxels, please visit the Avatar Distribution Page.
If we can enjoy Teravit using original characters, then why don't we recreate some of the 鋼鉄戦記C21 characters?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/b5f46dc8bd158fcfa3160b9849b1a1fcebdd215b.jpg[/img]

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]


[h2]About the Global Alpha Test[/h2]During the Japanese Alpha Test in September, we received a lot of feedback and requests from players. We will be incorporating this feedback from the first Alpha Test in the Global Alpha Test on Steam.

The Global Alpha Test will be available from October 12th, 2021 (JST) until October 29th, 2021 (JST).



We hope to see everyone in Teravit and 鋼鉄戦記C21!
